entities.summary: Vincenza Beatrice Speraz, known by her literary pseudonym Bruno Sperani, was an Italian writer, best remembered for her novels Cesare (1879), L'avvocato Malpieri  (1888), Maddalena (1892), Emma Walder (1893), and The Lady of the Regina (1910).
